description: This script analyzes log files, parsing logcat output, aggregating statistics by tags, process IDs, and text content, and producing summarized reports on log data including counts and memory usage.

classes.name: Bucket
classes.description: Represents a collection of statistics for a specific key, tracking count, memory, and associated log lines.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Manages a collection of Bucket objects keyed by a specific attribute, providing methods to add data and sort by count or memory.

methods.name: ParseDuration
methods.description: Parses a duration string of format 'XwXdXhXmXs' into total seconds.

methods.name: FormatMemory
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with units (bytes, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: FormateTimeDelta
methods.description: Formats a timedelta object into a string matching the input duration format.

methods.name: WriteResult
methods.description: Outputs a formatted summary line for a statistics bucket.

methods.name: ParseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input file, duration, raw logs, and other options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates log parsing, data aggregation, and report generation.
